candidates.review_note: For a remaining interval of even length, alternating max/min endpoint deletion starting with the maximizer has value equal to the maximum of the two central entries. For odd length at least three it has value min(center,max(left-neighbor,right-neighbor)); length one returns its entry. These identities follow by induction using the distributive min/max laws (equivalently threshold each entry to a Boolean and simplify alternating adjacent AND/OR). The k preliminary deletions can select any contiguous interval of length n-k. Its central entries range over a symmetric slice of the original array, so the optimum is a range maximum of either the original entries or the three-entry odd values. Precompute maxima of all nested symmetric slices in linear time and emit every k result without dynamic programming over quadratic intervals.
